optical_proxy.method: Gaussian aperture and power transfer fitted to factory HIGH10k screenshot anchors, not to a desired endpoint
optical_proxy.scope: Empirical proxy, NOT measured PSF or new optical validation. Per-window factory optical references remain authoritative.

scope: 168 live DMA frames, independent parameter GET0x40044c46, capture latch0x4050, native restore; bright input4000/10000. Interpolation and other budgets/modes remain estimates.
contamination: GPU buffers have only the requested window; system cursor/overlays exist in some LDF/DMA frames outside the center. Central aperture weighting suppresses distant content; AW can still be scene-dependent. Not a clean-room optical calibration.
